title: knautia dipsacifolia subsp. gracilis
intro: Knautia dipsacifolia subsp. gracilis, commonly known as the shepherd's needles or shepherd's cushion, is a perennial plant in the family Caprifoliaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Knautia dipsacifolia subsp. gracilis include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which help to soothe wounds, reduce fever, and alleviate digestive problems. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
